name: ymusic-android
description: Android wrapper for YMusic with background media playback.

scripts.setup: npm run prepare:web && npx cap add android && node scripts/configure-android-background-playback.cjs
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android-background-playback.cjs
scripts.build:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
